description: A copy read from a copy behind at its old path, whose disk holds no folder at the file's new path, looks for that folder on the other disks present. With the disk that holds it, kept 0700, away, and the catalog saying that it holds it, the copy waits, io-error, before anything is copied or journaled, as a folder made with no model would stay open for good: it was made 0755. That disk back, the folder is made like it, 0700, its event holding its mode and owner (the maintainer, 2026-11-21).

steps.query: SELECT c.disk_id, CAST(f.lpath AS TEXT), CAST(c.old_lpath AS TEXT) FROM copies c JOIN files f ON f.id = c.file_id ORDER BY c.disk_id

steps.text:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[defaults]
replicas = 2
[[disk]]
id = "t2"
uuid = "7a2b4c6d-8e0f-4a1b-9c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t2"
fs = "ext4"
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
[[disk]]
id = "t3"
uuid = "4f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t3"
fs = "ext4"

steps.query: SELECT count(*) FROM ops WHERE disk_id = 't3'
SELECT src_disk, dst_disk, state, attempts FROM jobs
SELECT kind, state FROM ops WHERE disk_id = 't3' ORDER BY id
SELECT json_extract(data, '$.disk'), json_extract(data, '$.path'), json_extract(data, '$.mode'), json_type(data, '$.uid'), json_type(data, '$.gid') FROM events WHERE kind = 'mkdir'
SELECT CAST(lpath AS TEXT), mode, created_by FROM entries WHERE disk_id = 't3'
